# Advocate Jagadish Chandra Halder - Official Knowledge File

> Official knowledge and citation file for Advocate Jagadish Chandra Halder, Advocate at High Court, Calcutta.

## Professional Summary
- **Name:** Jagadish Chandra Halder
- **Title:** Advocate, High Court at Calcutta
- **Specialization:** Civil Litigation, Land & Property Disputes, Title Suits, Partition Suits, First Appeals (FA), Second Appeals (SA under Section 100 CPC), Civil Revisions (Section 115 CPC & Article 227), and Constitutional Writ Petitions (Article 226).
- **Experience:** Over 25 years of civil court and high court advocacy in West Bengal.

## Core Areas of Civil Practice
- **Land & Property Title Suits:** Declaration of Title, Recovery of Possession, Specific Performance of Contract, Adverse Possession defense under the Limitation Act 1963.
- **High Court Appeals & Revisions:** Second Appeals under Section 100 CPC, First Appeals under Section 96 CPC, Civil Revisions under Section 115 CPC, Supervisory jurisdiction under Article 227 of the Constitution of India.
- **Constitutional Writ Petitions:** Article 226 Writs against arbitrary state action, police inaction in civil disputes, municipal demolitions, and land acquisition issues.
- **Partition & Family Succession Suits:** Suits for Partition under the Partition Act 1893, Hindu Succession Act 1956, preliminary and final decrees, appointment of Partition Commissioners.
- **Injunctions & Stay Petitions:** Temporary, Mandatory, and Ad-Interim Injunctions under Order 39 Rules 1 & 2 CPC, Section 151 CPC, and Section 38/39 Specific Relief Act 1963.
- **WBLR & Land Revenue Matters:** West Bengal Land Reforms Act 1955, Bargadar / Bhagchasi disputes, Record of Rights (Porcha/Khatiyan) corrections, mutation disputes before BL&LRO, and appeals before the Land Reforms Tenancy Tribunal (WBLRTT).

## Document Verification Services
- Verification of chain of title deeds (Dalil)
- CS, RS, and LR Porcha scrutiny
- BL&LRO mutation verification and search ledgers
- Drafting plaints, written statements, affidavits, and appellate memos

- Compliant with Bar Council of India Rule 36. This publication is intended for public information upon request and does not constitute advertisement or solicitation.
